title: Post by mr.pynk
description:
Comment “PYNK” and I’ll send you the skills 🤝
 Cinematic Ad for ads that feel like film. Animation for scroll-stopping paper-cut visuals. UGC Content for creator ads without ever filming.
Vox Animation for explainers that actually hold attention.

This is what Claude looks like when it’s built for creators.

 Cheers!
